description: 국가철도공단 수도권1호선 엘리베이터 [railways and stations] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 수도권1호선에 포함된 도시광역철도역들의 엘리베이터 데이터로 철도운영기관명, 선명, 역명, 출입구번호, 상세위치, 정원인원, 정원중량의데이터가 있습니다. 1990년대부터 수도권 전철에서는. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 도시광역철도, 지하철엘리베이터, 수도권지하철1호선, 전철엘리베이터, 1호선엘리베이터. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
